descriptionFromApi:
Job Title: AI/ML Expert or Gen AI Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 5 to 8 Years


Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and deploy Gen AI solutions (e.g., chatbots, anomaly detectors) to automate incident triage, root cause analysis, and alerting in production environments.
- Integrate AI with existing tools like monitoring systems (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, Glass box, Catchpoint), ticketing platforms (e.g., Remedy or ServiceNow), and databases (e.g., Oracle) to improve observability.
- Develop custom AI agents or scripts using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Llama, GPT, etc.,) for natural language querying of logs, metrics, and codebases, accelerating MTTR from hours to minutes.
- Collaborate with production support teams to identify toil-heavy processes, prototype AI fixes, and measure impact via KPIs like resolution time and ticket volume.
- Build and maintain AI pipelines for continuous learning from production incidents, ensuring models improve over time without human retraining.
- Ensure AI solutions comply with security, data privacy, and reliability standards in high-stakes financial or enterprise apps.
- Train and upskill support teams on AI tools, fostering a culture of AI-driven efficiency.

Preferred Skills:
- Proficiency in Gen AI frameworks & Transformers for building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.
- Programming: Python (advanced), with experience in FastAPI, Streamlit for AI prototypes; SQL for database querying (Oracle preferred).
- Production support expertise: Incident management, log analysis, MTTR optimization in cloud (AWS/Azure) environment.
- AI ops: Model deployment via Docker/Kubernetes, monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana, handling drift and hallucinations.
- Data handling: Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), prompt engineering for domain-specific tasks like error prediction.

Desired Skills:
- MLOps tools: MLflow for CI/CD of AI models.
- Observability integration: Custom agents for tools.
- Domain knowledge: Global Banking, SRE practices (e.g., SLOs).
- Soft skills: Cross-functional communication, agile methodologies, experience converting AI in conservative teams.
- Emerging tech: Multimodal AI (e.g., vision for dashboard analysis), fine-tuning open-source models on proprietary incident data

Minimum Qualifications (MustHave) *

  • 58 years total experience, including 3–5 years of handson GenAI/automation work.
  • Strong Python skills for scripting, API integration, and automation

Job Title: AI/ML Expert or Gen AI Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 5 to 8 Years


Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and deploy Gen AI solutions (e.g., chatbots, anomaly detectors) to automate incident triage, root cause analysis, and alerting in production environments.
- Integrate AI with existing tools like monitoring systems (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, Glass box, Catchpoint), ticketing platforms (e.g., Remedy or ServiceNow), and databases (e.g., Oracle) to improve observability.
- Develop custom AI agents or scripts using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Llama, GPT, etc.,) for natural language querying of logs, metrics, and codebases, accelerating MTTR from hours to minutes.
- Collaborate with production support teams to identify toil-heavy processes, prototype AI fixes, and measure impact via KPIs like resolution time and ticket volume.
- Build and maintain AI pipelines for continuous learning from production incidents, ensuring models improve over time without human retraining.
- Ensure AI solutions comply with security, data privacy, and reliability standards in high-stakes financial or enterprise apps.
- Train and upskill support teams on AI tools, fostering a culture of AI-driven efficiency.

Preferred Skills:
- Proficiency in Gen AI frameworks & Transformers for building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.
- Programming: Python (advanced), with experience in FastAPI, Streamlit for AI prototypes; SQL for database querying (Oracle preferred).
- Production support expertise: Incident management, log analysis, MTTR optimization in cloud (AWS/Azure) environment.
- AI ops: Model deployment via Docker/Kubernetes, monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana, handling drift and hallucinations.
- Data handling: Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), prompt engineering for domain-specific tasks like error prediction.

Desired Skills:
- MLOps tools: MLflow for CI/CD of AI models.
- Observability integration: Custom agents for tools.
- Domain knowledge: Global Banking, SRE practices (e.g., SLOs).
- Soft skills: Cross-functional communication, agile methodologies, experience converting AI in conservative teams.
- Emerging tech: Multimodal AI (e.g., vision for dashboard analysis), fine-tuning open-source models on proprietary incident data

Minimum Qualifications (MustHave) *

  • 58 years total experience, including 3–5 years of handson GenAI/automation work.
  • Strong Python skills for scripting, API integration, and automation

Job title: Testing- AI engineer

Location: Pune, HYD

Experience: 5+ Years

Work Mode: Hybrid


Job Description:

JD for AI Engineers:

  • Total Work experience ~5-10 years
  • Frontier agentic models: Knowledge of Frontier agentic models (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini AI, Anthropic Claude etc.,) and building Agentic AI agents.
  • MCP with Testing agents Selenium, Appium, Playwright, JMeter, Roboframework, commercial tools like TOSCA, TDM, DevTest
  • Prompt Engineering & Evaluation: Prompting to solve a QA problem, Testing how agents respond to various instructions, chain-of-thought prompts, and few-shot techniques.
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript is required for scripting, analyzing agent traces, and customizing test environments. Rapid prototyping
  • System Architecture & Tooling: Ability to test AI interactions with external tools, APIs, databases, and web services (e.g., verifying tool selection and API payload accuracy).
  • DevOps expertise (SCM, Jenkins, Ansible)
  • Testing Expertise (Good to have):
    • Proficiency in testing tools, Agentic Testing Playwright, Performance Testing- Apache JMeter, API Testing tools Insomnia, Karate, REST Assured.
    • Writing scripts to automate test cases, debug, and monitor agent actions.
    • Validating agents functional and technical features, integration with external tools, APIs, and databases (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI).

  • Custom Platform Integration Engineering - Async Event-Driven Processing: Integrate heavy inference and document embedding pipelines into distributed message brokers and queues (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).

Job Details
Job Ref: SYSTE002727 Pune, Maharashtra, India Category: Technology Development Employment Type: Full Time
Overview
ABOUT UA/UNIFORM ADVANTAGE BRANDS
For over 40 years, UA Brands has designed fashion-forward apparel for the medical and culinary professionals who make a difference every day. We re proud to support the people behind the work, those showing up and making an impact every shift. We re a purpose-driven team with a strong commitment to community, collaboration, and service. Here, you ll find a culture that values connection, fresh perspectives, and real impact. From the start, we re committed to giving you an authentic look at life at UA Brands and how you can grow, contribute, and make your mark.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global organization. The Systems Administrator II will have a security-first mentality and will be responsible for design, development, deployment and maintenance of all IT Infrastructure solutions. This role will frequently contribute to global projects involving many other IT resources in a collaborative effort. The ideal candidate will be self-driven and goal-oriented, with a strong passion for technology and self-growth. Leveraging AI tools will be essential for day-to-day tasks as well as improving technology overall. AI security and administration, use of MCPs, agents and other AI technologies will be required. This role will include analysis, design and implementation of Microsoft solutions in a global enterprise environment. A strong background with Windows server OS, VMware 7 and above, SAN administration, Azure and AWS administration, clustering/load balancing in both on-prem and cloud solutions Advanced knowledge of PowerShell and various scripting languages are required for this position. This position will be joining a highly functional support team. Candidates should enjoy mentoring, training and collaborating with other team members to be successful in this role.
WHAT YOU LL DO
Strong administrative skills with VMware 7 and above, Windows OS 2012 and above, including clustering and load balancing
Maintain consistent hardware/software patch levels and firmware
In-depth knowledge and administration of Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure
Design, implement and maintain infrastructure solutions for new projects
Proficiency with Managing users/security/email in Active Directory and Azure AD/O365
Administer storage SANs and dedicated storage disks for all company data
Respond to higher tiered incidentals and after-hours calls and alerts from server/network notification system as required.
Manage and monitor backups and disaster recovery
Create and maintain all relevant documentation for SOPs, processes and policies
Deploy and maintain Windows servers and storage SANs in accordance with best practices in security, sustainability and other scopes
WHAT YOU LL BRING
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering with a specialization in Information Technology or Computer Science
  • Willingness to work follow flexible work-schedule, India Hours 12 PM IST to 9 PM IST. And if required, US Hours.
  • MCSE/Azure/AWS/VMware Certification - advanced level
  • Windows Server, Microsoft Azure, VMware 7+ - advanced level
  • PowerShell/VB Script/SQL/ Python scripting advanced level
  • TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, FTP/SFTP advanced level
  • Microsoft Exchange/Office 365, Azure Administration
  • Managing servers / storage / backups / security
  • Active Directory/Entra AD, Group Policy management
  • SAN administration
  • VMware Administration
  • Organization skills- ability to manage time, prioritize work, meet deadlines, and complete all assigned tasks
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication and strong interpersonal skills
  • Vendor management
WHERE YOU LL WORK
PERMANENT REMOTE Work from Home
Work from HomeHave workplace flexibility - you ll work exclusively from the comfort of your home with no commute! Remote employees are expected to be online and available during the core business hours for their team. Company computer equipment is provided for business use.
WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS
  • A quiet, private, distraction-free work environment without any conflicting responsibilities during your scheduled work shift. With 100 MBPS Internet speed and 9 hours of power backup.
WHY YOU LL LOVE WORKING HERE
UA BRANDS offers a full range of benefits that address both your health and financial needs.
  • Company-sponsored medical insurance for employees and family members
  • Company-sponsored Life insurance for employee
  • Company-sponsored Group Personal Accidental insurance for employee
  • Company-sponsored Gratuity Benefit
  • Continuous remote work
  • Hardship Allowance: Paid over and above the employees monthly salary
  • Extended Hardship Allowance: Paid over and above the employees monthly salary
  • Paid Vacation / Earned Leave
  • Maternity Leave, Compensatory Off Leave, Bereavement Leave, and Paternity Leave as per the applicable norms.
  • Holiday Pay
  • Referral Program - Get paid to work with Friends
  • Regular Recognition, Social Activities, Monthly Events, and Birthday Celebrations Mandatory Fun.
UA IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
As an employee of any UA Brands division, you will be part of an established and dynamic organization. We believe that success starts from within, and we are seeking individuals who thrive in an environment that encourages and supports self-management. To provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, employment decisions at UA Brands will be based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. UA Brands does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. UA Brands will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. We are a Drug-Free Workplace.


Follow UA Brands on Social Media

Contact Us
If you like what you ve heard about us so far and believe you re exactly the ambitious, self-motivated professional we need, we d love to meet you!

jobDescription:
Job_Description":"
As we expand our digital footprint, we are investing in AI-first discovery and search optimization (AEO) ensuring our platforms and content are accurately discovered, interpreted, and surfaced across AI-driven search engines and assistants.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Website Developer with expertise in AI Search Optimization (AEO) to lead the development of AI-ready digital experiences. This role goes beyond traditional SEOfocusing on structuring, engineering, and optimizing web content so it can be accurately interpreted and surfaced by AI-driven systems.
In addition, you will play a key role in building and managing a high-performance website using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring flexibility, scalability, and rapid content deployment aligned with AEO best practices.
You will ensure our digital presence is discoverable, interpretable, and prioritized in AI-generated responses .
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the development of corporate websites optimized for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) .
  • Design, develop, and maintain websites using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring performance, scalability, and ease of content updates.
  • Customize themes, templates, and plugins to support advanced content structuring and AI discoverability.
  • Structure content for AI readability and retrieval , including:
    • Direct answer formats
    • FAQ schemas
    • Topic clusters and semantic content models
    • Implement structured data (JSON-LD, schema.org) to enhance machine readability.
    • Apply semantic HTML and content hierarchy best practices .
    • Collaborate with content and marketing teams to identify high-value queries and AI search patterns .
    • Monitor how AI platforms (ChatGPT, Google SGE, Perplexity, etc.) surface content and optimize accordingly .
    • Continuously test and refine content structure, layout, and copy to improve AI answer accuracy.
    • Optimize knowledge bases, product pages, and corporate content for NLP and entity recognition.
    • Drive implementation of headless CMS / API-driven content architectures .

      Requirements
      Required Skills Experience
      Core Development
      • 810 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering .
      • Strong expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (semantic-first approach).
      • Extensive experience with WordPress development (custom themes, plugins, performance optimization).
      • Hands-on expertise with Elementor (custom widgets, templates, responsive design).
      • Experience with React, Next.js, or similar frameworks .
      • Hands-on experience with headless CMS platforms .
        AEO / AI Search
        • Strong understanding of AI search behavior and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) .
        • Experience with:
          • Structured data (JSON-LD, schema.org)
          • Knowledge graphs and semantic SEO
          • Content optimization for AI retrieval
          • Familiarity with AI assistants and conversational search .
            Analytics Optimization
            • Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, or similar tools .
            • Ability to measure and improve AI-driven visibility .
              Good to Have
              • Technical SEO (crawlability, indexing, site architecture)
              • Experience optimizing WordPress performance (Core Web Vitals, caching, CDN integration)
              • Exposure to API-first / microservices architectures
              • Basic understanding of LLMs, RAG, or embeddings
              • Experience in B2B SaaS environments

                Benefits

Paytm is Indias leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR Soundbox is one of Paytm s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification:-
Graduate/Post Graduate.

Compensation:-
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers merchants - and we are committed to it. India s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Job Summary

EY GDS - Data and Analytics (DA) - DBT, BigQuery, Airflow - Data Engineer - Senior

As part of our EY-GDS DA (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the power of data and technology. We work across industries including Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Supply Chain, and Finance to deliver scalable and innovative data solutions.

The Opportunity

We're looking for candidates with strong experience in modern data engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in building and managing end-to-end data pipelines, data transformation using dbt, and working with Google BigQuery and Apache Airflow. Experience in data warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema design, and Wealth Asset Management (WAM) data domains is preferred.

Your Technical Responsibilities

  • Design, build, orchestrate, and manage end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Develop scalable and maintainable data transformation workflows using dbt.
  • Participate in the full software and data development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across data platforms.
  • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following engineering best practices.
  • Work with structured and semi-structured data sources to support analytics and reporting needs.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize existing data pipelines and workflows.
  • Develop, test, and maintain high-quality software and data engineering solutions using Python.

Requirements (Qualifications)

  • BE/BTech/MCA with 3 to 5 years of relevant industry experience.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

  • 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering.
  • Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling.
  • Experience in building and managing end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Google BigQuery.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT, and Star/Snowflake schema design.
  • Proficiency in Python for data engineering and automation.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to a fast-paced development environment.

Primary Skills

  • Data Build Tool (DBT)
  • Google BigQuery
  • Apache Airflow
  • Proven experience in building, orchestrating and managing end-to-end data pipelines

Good to have

  • Python

Ideally, You'll Also Have

  • Client management and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
  • Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and modern data architecture concepts.

What We Look For

  • Professionals with strong technical capabilities and a passion for data engineering.
  • Individuals who are eager to learn and adapt to emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Team players who can deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment.

We provide the core building blocks for identity lifecycle, governance, authentication, authorization and privileged access management that protect customer trust and empower every Salesforce engineer to operate securely, regardless of environment.

We are seeking a full-stack software engineer with a track record of building modern, secure services and applications following the Software Development Life Cycle and best security development practices. This is a hands-on software engineering role with a focus on the IAM domain. You will design and build end-to-end capabilities from backend services and APIs to the user-facing experiences that power identity lifecycle (human/non-human), access requests, provisioning, entitlement/role management, access certifications, and policy-driven access decisions at enterprise scale.

You will also own features through the full development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. Youll partner across application owners, product management, and governance to translate identity and compliance requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable solutions. Role Name: Analyst - AI Project Desk
At Kapture CX, we are looking for an Analyst - AI Project Desk in our GTM > Customer Success and Growth team.
Who are we
Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations.
Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.
Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia.
What is this role all about
You ll be the data and insights backbone of Kapture s AI Project Desk , helping track how AI solutions perform after deployment across customer accounts. You ll turn account-level data into actionable insights-helping identify adoption gaps, measure business outcomes, spot risks, and uncover opportunities to scale AI solutions.
This is a high-ownership role where you ll work closely with Delivery, Product, and Account teams to build visibility into AI adoption and help turn pilots into successful, scalable deployments.
Sounds interesting
Here s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
You ll maintain and update the AI Adoption ROI Tracker , ensuring accurate visibility into AI product usage, adoption, performance, and business outcomes across customer accounts.
You ll analyse account-level data to identify adoption gaps, performance trends, risks, and accounts that are stuck at the Pilot or early Adoption stage.
You ll build dashboards, reports, QBR inputs, customer adoption reviews, and ROI reports that help Account and AI Project Desk teams make informed decisions.
You ll track AI deployments across the Pilot Adoption Scale Expansion journey and work with Account and Delivery teams to collect and maintain relevant customer and performance data.
You ll identify patterns across accounts and use cases, contribute to case studies and benchmarks, and generate reusable insights that can improve AI adoption and scalability.
This is a Bangalore-based role . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
What does success look like in this role
You ll create reliable visibility into AI adoption and performance across customer accounts, identify gaps and risks early, and provide actionable insights that help improve customer outcomes. You ll also help build the data foundation required to convert AI pilots into scaled and repeatable use cases.
What would make you a good fit for this role
Here are the basic requirements:
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with large datasets and identify meaningful trends.
You re comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets and dashboards to track, analyse, and present business metrics.
You have strong attention to detail and take ownership of maintaining accurate data and documentation.
You can work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and collaborate with Delivery, Product, and Account teams.
What are the most critical skills for this role
You can analyse account-level data and translate numbers into clear insights, risks, and actionable recommendations.
You can build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reports that provide clear visibility into customer and business performance.
You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to internal teams and clients.
You can approach ambiguous problems logically, identify root causes, and recommend practical actions to improve AI adoption and outcomes.
You will have an advantage if you:
You have experience working with AI, SaaS, customer success, customer experience, or product adoption .
You have experience tracking customer usage, adoption, ROI, business outcomes, or product performance.
You have experience with tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar analytics and BI platforms .
You have experience preparing QBRs, customer reviews, case studies, benchmarks, or ROI reports .
Why should you be interested
Here s what you will gain from this role:
You ll work at the intersection of AI, SaaS, analytics, and customer outcomes , gaining exposure to how enterprise AI solutions are adopted and scaled.
You ll work closely with Product, Delivery, and Account teams and get direct visibility into customer use cases and business outcomes.
You ll have the opportunity to help build the data, reporting, and analytical foundation of a growing AI function from the ground up.
You ll contribute to identifying what makes AI deployments successful and help create repeatable approaches for scaling AI across customers.

The Payments Platform team at HighLevel builds and scales the payment orchestration layer that powers every transaction across our ecosystem from invoices and subscriptions to point-of-sale and mobile checkout. We are seeking a Product Manager II, Payment Orchestration , who will own the roadmap and execution for HighLevel s orchestration platform spanning the orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress . You will be responsible for the reliability, breadth, and developer experience of the platform that every payment surface at HighLevel is built on top of.
The ideal candidate combines product judgment with technical fluency, comfortable reasoning about payment routing, PSP integrations, idempotency, and event delivery , while keeping adoption, transaction success, and customer trust at the center of every decision. This is a role for someone who wants to go deep on payments infrastructure and translate that depth into measurable product outcomes.
Your mission: To build a reliable, extensible, and provider-agnostic payment orchestration platform that maximizes transaction success and powers fast, secure, and seamless payment experiences across HighLevel s global customer base.


What You ll Do
  • Own the Orchestration Roadmap Execution - Define and deliver the roadmap for the payment orchestration platform, spanning the orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress , with a strong focus on reliability, coverage, and transaction success.
  • Drive Payment Routing Provider Strategy - Improve authorization rates and cost efficiency through smart routing, provider selection, retries, and failover across multiple PSPs and gateways.
  • Own the Transaction Lifecycle - Lead the end-to-end handling of authorizations, captures, refunds, voids, and disputes , ensuring correctness, idempotency, and state integrity at scale.
  • Deliver Reliable Webhook Ingress - Build robust inbound webhook processing that normalizes, deduplicates, and reliably fans out provider events to downstream services with strong delivery guarantees.
  • Ship Trustworthy Receipts Records - Own accurate, well-formatted receipts and transaction records that give customers and their end users clear, trustworthy proof of every payment.
  • Elevate Platform APIs Developer Experience - Partner with engineering to design clean, well-documented payment APIs and events that internal teams and product surfaces can build on with confidence.
  • Champion Reliability Observability - Treat uptime, latency, and error rates as first-class product metrics, driving instrumentation, alerting, and reconciliation to keep the platform accurate and dependable.
  • Ensure Scale, Security Compliance - Own PCI, risk, and data-integrity considerations , ensuring the platform stays secure, scalable, and compliant as volume grows.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally - Work closely with engineering, design, data, risk, support, and partner-facing teams to align the platform with the needs of every payment surface it powers.
  • Leverage Payments Data for Decisions - Use metrics such as authorization rates, transaction success, failure reasons, latency, and reconciliation gaps to prioritize the roadmap and measure impact.
  • Own Outcomes, Not Just Features - Deliver measurable improvements in transaction success, platform reliability, and provider coverage , and in the experience of the teams building on the platform.

  • Strategic and Execution-Focused - You can shape a clear roadmap for your area while staying deeply involved in execution to ensure ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

title: Sr. Product Analyst - AI Products
tagsAndSkills: cloud data,mixpanel,operating system,ai,analytics tools,business analytics,llm,artificial intelligence
jobDescription:
Role Overview

HighLevel's AI portfolio spans more than a dozen products, from conversational and voice agents that handle customer interactions on a business's behalf to copilots that help operators run the business itself. These products are sold both as a bundled subscription and on a pay-per-use basis, across a base of more than a million sub-accounts.

As Senior Product Analyst for AI Products, you will own the measurement of that portfolio. You will run the recurring business review, maintain the metric definitions for each product, report performance against the operating plan, and analyse retention, adoption and the unit economics of AI usage. Your work will inform the AI roadmap and will feed into quarterly and board-level reviews.

The role is hands-on. You will write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, build the reporting layer in Superset, and take responsibility for whether a figure is correct before anyone acts on it. You will work directly with the VP of Product and with the product managers who own each AI product, and we will expect you to form a view on what the data means and to defend it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the recurring business review for the AI portfolio, from building the underlying analysis through to presenting the results to product leadership.
  • Define and document the metrics for each AI product, including activation, adoption, the north star metric and penetration, and keep those definitions consistent across every report.
  • Build and maintain the Superset datasets, charts and dashboards the AI team depends on, and audit the existing reporting for hardcoded filters, stale queries and definitions that have drifted.
  • Write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, including against semi-structured JSON columns, to answer the questions our dashboards cannot.
  • Report each products performance against the annual operating plan and subsequent re-forecasts, and explain the variances in terms of what happened in the product.
  • Analyse retention, cohort behaviour and adoption funnels at the sub-account level, and establish where and why accounts stop using a product.
  • Build the unit economics of AI usage, converting token consumption into cost by model and reporting cost-to-revenue ratio and margin by product.
  • Report on AI product quality, covering version-over-version evaluation results, containment and escalation rates, and the sampling design behind those figures.
  • Reconcile figures that disagree between sources, and decide which source should be used to answer which question.
  • Specify instrumentation with product managers before a feature ships, analyse in-product behaviour in Pendo once it has, and size the opportunities and experiments that go into the roadmap.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • At least six years of experience in product or business analytics, including time spent working directly with product teams.
  • Strong SQL skills. You should be able to write multi-CTE queries, window functions and cohort logic without assistance, query semi-structured JSON in Snowflake, and move into Python or R for the work SQL cannot do.
  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally ClickHouse and Snowflake.
  • The ability to author in Superset or Tableau, including building datasets and dashboards, and to open an existing chart definition and work out what it actually measures.
  • Experience with a product analytics tool such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel, including defining events and tracking plans.
  • Experience owning a recurring metrics pack or business review that other people depended on.
  • Careful attention to data grain and time period. You should check whether a figure is measured at the account or sub-account level before using it, and recognise what an incomplete period does to a cohort table.
  • A good command of SaaS metrics, including MRR and ARR movements, expansion and contraction, churn, retention and ARPU.
  • Enough statistical grounding to size and read an experiment honestly, and to say when a result is too noisy to act on.
  • Clear written English. A large part of this job is explaining an analysis in a short piece of writing that a busy reader can act on.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience analysing an AI or LLM product, particularly token consumption, model cost and quality evaluation.
  • Familiarity with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the reporting problems they create.
  • Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer.
  • A background in CRM, agency or SMB SaaS products.
  • Experience with subscription analytics tools such as ChartMogul.

descriptionFromApi:
About Vista Equity Partners
Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations - reinforcing India s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.
Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio - enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.
About Amtech
Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics - empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.
With Vista s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.
Our Employee Value Proposition
At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:
Purpose
Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.
Growth
Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista s global network - accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.
Culture
Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.
Innovation
Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.
Role Description
Amtech is strengthening its India-based IT Delivery Services capability to ensure reliable, secure, and responsive technology services. The Senior IT Engineer is a senior, hands-on technical contributor responsible for in-person Bengaluru office coverage and India time-zone execution across End User computing, infrastructure, endpoint, identity and core enterprise services.
This role blends deep technical operations expertise with modernization, automation, and continuous improvement. Working closely with global IT Delivery Services peers, Cloud, and Security teams, this engineer will help ensure Amtech s hybrid environment is resilient, scalable, and aligned with security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and ISO 27001).
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
India Site Regional Service Coverage (Primary)
  • Provide in-person IT support for the Bengaluru office, including urgent break/fix, hardware swaps, imaging, conference room/AV troubleshooting and office network/Wi-Fi support.
  • Own local time-zone execution for incidents, requests, and changes impacting the org; coordinate escalations and handoffs with global teams to maintain service continuity.
  • Partner with HR/Facilities and business stakeholders to support onboarding/offboarding logistics, office moves/changes, and local technology planning.
  • Coordinate and manage local IT vendors (circuits, cabling, hardware repair, disposal) and track SLA performance.
Infrastructure Operations Engineering
  • Operate and improve Amtech s hybrid environment spanning Microsoft 365, and on-prem/VDC services at Contour (as applicable).
  • Administer and troubleshoot core enterprise services including identity, access, endpoint connectivity, network services, and collaboration platforms.
  • Manage networking and remote access capabilities (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi/VPN, firewalls) to ensure reliability, performance, and secure connectivity.
  • Maintain and enhance monitoring/alerting coverage for key infrastructure and site services to ensure uptime, performance, and rapid issue detection.
  • Execute planned upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle activities for infrastructure components, coordinating change windows and validation.
Endpoint Engineering Device Lifecycle
  • Drive endpoint deployment and configuration for India-based employees using Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager (and related capabilities such as Autopilot, compliance policies, and configuration baselines).
  • Support macOS management via JAMF (or equivalent) if applicable, ensuring consistent configuration and security posture.
  • Ensure effective patching, encryption, and endpoint health practices in coordination with Security (EDR, vulnerability remediation workflows, compliance signals).
  • Manage the end-to-end asset lifecycle: procurement coordination, receiving, inventory accuracy, secure handling/chain-of-custody, and certified secure disposal.
ITSM, Reliability Continuous Improvement
  • Operate within ITSM processes for incident, request, change, and problem management; help improve consistency, measurement, and outcomes.
  • Drive post-incident reviews and corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs) to reduce recurrence and improve reliability.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge articles to improve operational maturity and reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR).
Automation Modernization
  • Develop and maintain automation to streamline endpoint provisioning, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Support modernization initiatives such as Zero Trust-aligned controls, identity-based access improvements, and standardization of tooling and configurations.
Security Compliance Support (Operational)
  • Implement and support operational controls aligned with SOC 2 and ISO 27001, including asset management, access management coordination, change discipline, and evidence support.
  • Partner with Security on endpoint compliance reporting, vulnerability remediation tracking, and control testing support for audits.
Collaboration Knowledge Sharing
  • Work closely with IT Delivery Services leadership and engineering peers across time zones to standardize services and ensure clear handoffs.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and peer coaching through documentation, automation patterns, and operational improvements (non-people-management role).
Success in the First 90 Days (Expected Outcomes)
  • Contribute to dependable India in-person support coverage with clear intake, escalation, and SLA expectations.
  • Improve India endpoint operational rigor: measurable compliance reporting (patching, encryption, device health), reduced onboarding friction, and better inventory accuracy.
  • Reduce repeat incidents by addressing the top recurring failure patterns through runbooks, automation, and preventative maintenance.
  • Validate India site monitoring/alerting and close critical observability gaps for network and core services.
SKILLS QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, endpoint engineering, or enterprise IT operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Windows, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) in a production enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing endpoints at scale using Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager (Autopilot, compliance, configuration, patching workflows).
  • Solid networking fundamentals and troubleshooting depth (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls, DNS/DHCP concepts).
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues across endpoint, identity, network, and service layers.
  • Experience working within structured operational processes (incident/change/problem management) and producing high-quality documentation/runbooks.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including comfort working across distributed global teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with macOS device management (JAMF) in mixed-device fleets.
  • Experience supporting environments with AWS services and hybrid connectivity patterns.
  • Experience with on-prem/VDC environments and hybrid integration.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles, Conditional Access patterns, device compliance signals, and modern security controls.
  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, New Relic, or equivalents).
  • Relevant certifications (preferred, not required):
  • Microsoft (e.g., Azure Administrator / Endpoint Administrator)
  • CompTIA A+ / Network+
What This Role Offers
  • A high-impact IT role supporting a globally integrated IT Delivery Services organization with meaningful modernization opportunities.
  • Hands-on ownership of India site coverage and regional execution, with strong partnership across global IT, Cloud, and Security teams.
  • Exposure to security and compliance-driven operations (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) in a maturing, standards-based IT environment.
  • Opportunity to drive automation, standardization, and measurable improvements in reliability and employee experience.
Why Join Amtech
At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista s world-class ecosystem. You ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech - backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.

Technical Skills & Tools

  • Containers & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm
  • Observability & monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger (tracing), ELK/Elastic
  • Reliability practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident command, capacity planning, failure-mode analysis
  • Incident & on-call: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, blameless post-mortems
  • Automation & scripting: Python, Go, Bash, Git
  • AI-assisted operations: AI SRE tooling, AIOps, anomaly detection, automated RCA
  • DevOps (good to have): CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Terraform modules, GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm

Soft Skills & Competencies

  • Confident, customer-facing communication.
  • Calm, decisive incident leadership.
  • Mentors and raises standards across the team.
  • Sound technical judgement.

Experience Required

6-9 years.


Reporting & Team

Embedded with an enterprise customer as their primary technical point of contact, within our Forward Deployed Engineering practice; works alongside client engineers and mentors associate engineers.


Location & Work Model

  • Location: Bengaluru or Hyderabad.
  • Work model: Forward-deployed and customer-facing; embedded within an enterprise client's team.
  • Working hours: Overlap with client business hours (including US / EST); leads on-call coverage.

  • Build evaluation harnesses that measure output quality objectively rather than by impression
  • Build AI-driven automation that removes repetitive manual work, and scale it reliably as usage grows
  • Integrate LLMs and ML models into production: API endpoints, inference services, orchestration, and supporting pipelines
  • Work with AI orchestration and agent frameworks, and integrate with external tools and services
  • Instrument AI systems for observability token usage, latency, cost, failure modes, and output quality over time
  • Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to take models from notebook to production

  • Stay updated with a fast-moving AI ecosystem, and bring back what's worth adopting

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of backend development experience in Python
  • Hands-on AI workflow experience
  • Strong command of Python and at least one Python web framework (FastAPI, Django, or Flask)
  • Familiarity with MySQL and BigQuery, including schema design and query optimization
  • Working knowledge of core AI engineering concepts: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, guardrails, context management, and evaluation
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and frameworks LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar), and vector stores
  • Experience building AI-assisted automation and scaling it beyond a proof of concept
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, HTTP, JSON, and integration with external services
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, and security best practices across services and APIs
  • Proven ability to optimize applications for performance, scalability, and maintainability
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills
  • Logical thinking and a solution-oriented approach able to break down an unfamiliar problem and work toward a workable answer
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams frontend, product, QA, data, and operations

  • B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent. Equivalent practical experience will be considered.

Good to Have (Advantage)

How we work

We embrace AI-assisted engineering. We'd like you to use AI pair-programming tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a force multiplier while retaining full ownership, review, and understanding of the code you ship.

feasibility assessments, intake support, review materials, and alignment with enterprise

solution performance, defining and tracking business-value metrics, identifying

opportunities to reduce AI-related run costs, improving efficiency of AI-enabled

descriptionFromApi:
We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer to design and execute end-to-end testing strategies for agentic AI solutions, including multi-agent systems in production-grade environments. This role partners with the Agentic Operations Team to ensure resiliency, reliability, accuracy, latency, orchestration correctness, and scale. You will establish QA frameworks, build reusable test artifacts, drive macro-level validations across complex workflows, and lead the QA function for Agentic AI from Dev to Prod.


Key Responsibilities

  • Agentic & MultiAgent Development/Testing
  • Reliability, Resiliency, and Latency
  • Accuracy & Macro-Level Validations
  • Scale & Orchestration
  • Dev Prod Readiness
  • Define and own the QA strategy for agentic/multi-agent AI systems across dev, staging, and prod.
  • Mentor a team of QA engineers; establish testing standards, coding guidelines for test harnesses, and review practices.
  • Partner with Agentic Operations, Data Science, MLOps, and Platform teams to embed QA in the SDLC and incident response.
  • Design tests for agent orchestration, tool calling, planner-executor loops, and inter-agent coordination (e.g., task decomposition, handoff integrity, and convergence to goals).
  • Validate state management, context windows, memory/knowledge stores, and prompt/graph correctness under varying conditions.
  • Implement scenario fuzzing (e.g., adversarial inputs, prompt perturbations, tool latency spikes, degraded APIs).
  • Create resilience testing suites: chaos experiments, failover, retries/backoff, circuit-breaking, and degraded mode behavior.
  • Establish latency SLOs and measure end-to-end response times across orchestration layers (LLM calls, tool invocations, queues).
  • Ensure reliability through soak tests, canary verifications, and automated rollbacks.
  • Define ground-truth and reference pipelines for task accuracy (exact match, semantic similarity, factuality checks).
  • Build macro validation frameworks that validate task outcomes across multi-step agent workflows (e.g., complex data pipelines, content generation + verification agent loops).
  • Instrument guardrail validations (toxicity, PII, hallucination, policy compliance).
  • Design load/stress tests for multi-agent graphs under scale (concurrency, throughput, queue depth, backpressure).
  • Validate orchestrator correctness (DAG execution, retries, branching, timeouts, compensation paths).
  • Engineer reusable test artifacts (scenario configs, synthetic datasets, prompt libraries, agent graph fixtures, simulators).
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD (pre-merge gates, nightly, canary) and production monitoring with alerting tied to KPIs.
  • Define release criteria and run operational readiness (performance, security, compliance, cost/latency budgets).

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Software Development/Testing, with 2+ years in AI/ML or LLM-based systems; hands-on experience testing agentic/multi-agent architectures.
  • Strong programming skills in Python experience building test harnesses, simulators, and fixtures.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation (exact/soft match, BLEU/ROUGE, BERTScore, semantic similarity via embeddings), guardrails, and prompt testing.
  • Expertise in distributed systems testing latency profiling, resiliency patterns (circuit breakers, retries), chaos engineering, and message queues.
  • Familiarity with orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy, OpenAI Assistants/Actions, Azure OpenAI orchestration, or similar).
  • Proficiency with CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog), and feature flags/canaries.
  • Solid understanding of privacy/security/compliance in AI systems (PII handling, content policies, model safety).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills; proven ability to work cross-functionally with Ops, Data, and Engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent simulators, agent graph testing, and tooling latency emulation.
  • Knowledge of MLOps (model versioning, datasets, evaluation pipelines) and A/B experimentation for LLMs.
  • Background in cloud (AWS), serverless, containerization, and event-driven architectures.
  • Prior ownership of cost/latency/SLAs for AI workloads in production.

Transformation Analyst - Agentic Process Transformation

Rights & Royalties Transformation

Role Summary

We are seeking a high-impact Business Transformation Analyst to help modernise the Rights & Royalties operating model through AI-enabled agents, workflow automation, process simplification and measurable efficiency gains. This role is designed for someone who can understand operational pain points quickly, convert them into practical automation opportunities, and deliver adoption-ready solutions that improve speed, quality, control and stakeholder experience.


The ideal candidate combines structured business analysis with a maker mindset: able to map processes, define requirements, build low-code/agentic solutions, partner with technology teams, and track outcomes through clear KPIs. Hands-on data capability remains important, but the emphasis is on using data, AI and automation to transform recurring operational work, not on deep engineering or specialist BI development.


Royalties, rights, licensing, finance operations, publishing/media or revenue-share experience will be a strong advantage, particularly where it supports understanding of contracts, statements, payments, deductions, reserves, exceptions, approvals and audit sensitivity.


Key Objectives - What Success Looks Like

  • Create practical AI agents and guided automations that reduce manual effort, improve response quality and accelerate decision-making across Rights & Royalties operations.
  • Simplify and standardise recurring workflows such as exception triage, approvals, reconciliations, case routing, notifications, quality checks and reporting packs.
  • Deliver measurable efficiency gains through cycle-time reduction, lower rework, improved SLA performance, better adoption and stronger process controls.
  • Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and adoption plans.
  • Enable operational leaders with concise, self-serve visibility into risks, bottlenecks, productivity, quality and customer impact.

Core Responsibilities

1) Process Transformation & Business Analysis

  • Conduct rapid discovery of current-state processes, pain points, root causes, handoffs, control gaps and duplication across Rights, Royalties and related Finance Operations.
  • Design future-state workflows using a transformation lens: Simplify -> Standardise -> Automate -> Augment with AI -> Scale.
  • Convert business needs into crisp requirements, user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
  • Prioritise opportunities based on effort, impact, control risk, adoption readiness and efficiency potential.
  • Support UAT, adoption, change communication, training aids and post-launch benefit tracking.

2) Agent Creation & AI-enabled Solutions

  • Help design, configure and improve business-facing agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  • Translate operational use cases into agent capabilities such as document review support, answer retrieval, exception explanation, guided decisioning, case summarisation and next-best-action recommendations.
  • Define agent knowledge sources, prompts/instructions, guardrails, escalation paths, testing scenarios, success metrics and adoption feedback loops.
  • Partner with technology, governance and business stakeholders to ensure agents are controlled, explainable, secure, measurable and fit for production use.
  • Identify where agents should be combined with workflows, for example where AI reasoning is needed within a structured approval, triage or notification process.

3) Workflow Automation & Operational Enablement

  • Build or support low-code automations using Power Automate, Copilot Studio workflows and connected Microsoft 365 services.
  • Automate high-volume, rule-led and repeatable activities including validations, approvals, reminders, case routing, exception logging, report refreshes and stakeholder notifications.
  • Design automations with appropriate audit trails, handoffs, fallback logic, approval controls, ownership and maintainability.
  • Work with operations teams to ensure automation is embedded into daily routines rather than remaining as a standalone tool.

4) Insights, KPIs & Benefit Realisation

  • Define outcome-led KPI frameworks for automation and process transformation, focused on hours saved, cycle time, quality, SLA, adoption, controls and customer impact.

  • Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance or Legal stakeholders.

title: Software Development Engineer
tagsAndSkills: Artificial Intelligence,.NET,C#,NoSQL,Azure Cloud,LLM Integrations,SQL Server,Angular
jobDescription:
About Milestone

Milestone Inc. is a leading Digital Experience Software and Services company dedicated to providing comprehensive solutions across all touch points that enhance customer engagement and drive business growth. Milestones mission is to pioneer the distribution and visibility of content with an innovative platform that drives discovery, personalised experiences, and conversions powered by data and AI. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

We are looking for a highly competent and self-motivated Software Engineer to join the CMS product engineering team. In this role you will be a core contributor to product development using the Microsoft technology stack, writing effective, reusable, and modular code backed by unit tests. You will work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, agile environment alongside a talented cross-functional team.


Problems We Are Looking to Solve

  • Building scalable, maintainable features on top of a large-scale distributed product platform.
  • Improving reliability and performance of CMS modules used by 2,000+ enterprise customers.
  • Raising engineering quality through test-driven development, code reviews, and CI/CD discipline.
  • Accelerating feature velocity by introducing modern frontend patterns (Angular) alongside a mature .NET backend.
  • Driving cloud-readiness of product components through Azure services integration.
  • Reducing technical debt by refactoring legacy code into modular, documented, and well-tested units.

Key Responsibilities

Core Product Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features using C#/.NET and Angular 2.0+.
  • Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code with comprehensive unit and integration tests.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, contributing to team quality standards and knowledge sharing.
  • Work within SQL Server and MongoDB to design efficient schemas and performant queries.
  • Integrate Azure cloud services into product components as required.

Engineering Practices & Delivery

  • Participate in Scrum ceremonies sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git with sound branching and merging practices.
  • Follow test-driven development (TDD) practices; own test coverage for delivered features.
  • Diagnose and resolve bugs, performance issues, and technical incidents in owned modules.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions for new features.

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Develop and maintain Docker-based containerised application components.
  • Build with awareness of distributed, event-driven system patterns used across the platform.
  • Support integration with CMS platforms as feature requirements dictate.
  • Contribute to cloud cost efficiency and performance optimization in Azure deployments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A sharp, self-driven software engineer with strong fundamentals in the Microsoft stack, a bias for quality, and the ability to thrive in a product-focused engineering culture. You write code youre proud of, test what you ship, and bring a collaborative mindset to everything you build. Experience in a product-based software company is a strong differentiator.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • MCA or BE/BTech in Computer Science or equivalent discipline.
  • 1-3 years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft technology stack (C#/.NET, SQL Server).
  • 1+ years of experience with Angular 2.0 or above.
  • Proven experience building large-scale distributed applications with event-based programming patterns.
  • Strong foundations in algorithms and data structures.
  • Working knowledge of Azure cloud services.
  • Proficiency with Git, CI/CD workflows, branching strategies, and Scrum methodology.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms is an advantage.
  • Experience with Docker-based containerised applications is an advantage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Prior experience in a SaaS product-based company is strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience with AI-assisted coding tools will be a strong advantage.

Key Focus Areas

  • Feature delivery quality and test coverage on C#/.NET and Angular modules
  • CI/CD pipeline health and Git discipline
  • Azure cloud service integration and cloud-aware development
  • Distributed system performance and scalability
  • Engineering craftsmanship: clean code, documentation, and modular design

Capabilities

Technical Capabilities ||

  • Full-stack development (C#/.NET, Angular)
  • SQL Server & NoSQL (MongoDB) databases
  • Azure cloud services integration
  • CI/CD, Git branching & test-driven development
  • Docker & containerised application development
  • Distributed & event-driven system design
  • Algorithms and data structures
  • CMS platforms (added advantage)

KPIs and Metrics

KPI - Target || Benchmark

  • Code quality & test coverage - Unit test coverage 80% on owned modules
  • Sprint delivery reliability - Story points committed vs. completed 90%
  • Bug escape rate - Zero critical bugs in production from owned code
  • CI/CD pipeline health - Build success rate 95%; all failures resolved within same sprint
  • Code review participation - Reviews completed within 1 business day
  • On-call & incident response - Acknowledgement of P1 issues within 30 minutes
  • Documentation - All features shipped with up-to-date technical docs

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including Mediclaim and paid holidays.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment where engineers have real ownership.
  • Strong career growth and professional development opportunities.
  • Opportunity to build and ship products used by leading global brands in Hospitality, Retail, Financial Services, and Automotive.
  • Employee referral incentive programme.

Job Description AI/ML Engineer (Generative AI)

Experience: 5+ years overall, with 3+ years dedicated to Generative AI/LLM projects (Mid-Level)
Location: Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview
We are looking for a mid-level AI/ML Engineer with a strong foundation in software/data engineering and substantial hands-on Generative AI experience. The ideal candidate has moved beyond foundational GenAI exposure into building and owning production-grade RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and cloud-native AI services on Azure — someone who can work independently on moderately complex problems without requiring architectural oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build end-to-end RAG pipelines — document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing, retrieval, and reranking
  • Develop and integrate LLM-powered applications using LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel, including multi-step/agentic workflows
  • Own prompt engineering and optimization for accuracy, consistency, and cost efficiency across use cases
  • Deploy and manage AI services using Azure OpenAI Service / Azure AI Foundry, with working knowledge of AKS or containerized deployment
  • Build and maintain scalable APIs (FastAPI/Flask) to expose AI capabilities to downstream applications
  • Implement and troubleshoot vector search solutions (FAISS, Azure AI Search) including hybrid search and relevance tuning
  • Apply MLOps/LLMOps practices — model versioning, monitoring, logging, and performance evaluation of deployed AI systems
  • Collaborate directly with product, data engineering, and backend teams to translate business requirements into working AI features
  • Mentor junior team members on GenAI implementation practices as needed
  • Independently debug and resolve production issues related to AI service performance, latency, and retrieval accuracy

Required Skills

  • 5+ years total experience in software/data engineering or ML, with 3+ years specifically in Generative AI/LLM-based development
  • Demonstrated ownership of RAG architecture — not just consumption of existing pipelines
  • Solid working experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel
  • Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI Service or Azure AI Foundry in a production or near-production setting
  • Strong Python programming skills; comfortable with asynchronous programming and REST API design
  • Practical understanding of vector databases and semantic search tuning (hybrid retrieval, reranking, RRF)
  • Working knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps concepts — model monitoring, CI/CD for AI services
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of features end-to-end

Good to Have

  • Exposure to observability/evaluation tools (LangSmith, LangFuse, TruLens, RAGAS)
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes for AI service deployment
  • Exposure to enterprise domains — BFSI, retail, pharma, or similar
  • Familiarity with Azure Document Intelligence or intelligent document processing (IDP)

Education

  • B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
